name: diag_t01v2_s15_provisional_lookflip_02
command:
import json,hashlib,shutil,datetime
from pathlib import Path
from src.tools import t01v2_live_progress as live
from src.envs import pair_v2_flip_ranked_policy as policy
root=live.ROOT
name='diag_t01v2_s15_provisional_lookflip_02'
directory=root/'logs/runs'/name/'evidence'
directory.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
out=root/'logs/review/t01v2_s15_provisional_lookflip_02'
out.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
live.MODULES=(policy.PRODUCER,)
old_verify=live.verify_source_identity
def verify_live_complete_shard(data,gate,**kwargs):
 data['config']={**data['config']['shard'],**data['config']}
 with policy.camera_support():
  return old_verify(data,gate,**kwargs)
live.verify_source_identity=verify_live_complete_shard
selected={
'pilot_pairs_v2_flip60_fp203_s15_r01_j707737_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan203':['floorplan203_00002','floorplan203_00004'],
'pilot_pairs_v2_flip60_fp204_s15_r01_j707740_hopper_m_02_g0_floorplan204':['floorplan204_00038']}
rows=[]
bindings=[]
for source,pids in selected.items():
 lograw,logextent=live.read_prefix(root/'logs/runs'/(source+'.log'))
 logref=live.archive(lograw,directory,source+'_log.prefix')
 binding,gate=live.bind_live(source,lograw.decode(),directory)
 bindings.append(binding)
 raw,extent=live.read_prefix(root/'data/world_pairs/v2'/(source+'_attempts.jsonl'))
 journalref=live.archive(raw,directory,source+'_journal.prefix')
 attempts=[json.loads(x) for x in raw.decode().splitlines()]
 for pid in pids:
  matches=[r for r in attempts if r['pair_id']==pid]
  assert len(matches)==1
  row=matches[0]
  assert row['status']=='passed' and row['kind']=='look_flip' and row['scene']==binding['scene']
  p=root/row['pair_file']
  assert p.resolve()==(root/'data/world_pairs/v2'/source/pid/'pair.json').resolve()
  data=p.read_bytes()
  assert hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()==row['pair_sha256']
  pair=json.loads(data)
  assert pair['kind']=='look_flip'
  ref=pair['review_image']; img=root/ref['file']
  assert img.resolve().parent==p.resolve().parent
  imdata=img.read_bytes()
  assert hashlib.sha256(imdata).hexdigest()==ref['sha256']
  target=out/(pid+'.png')
  with target.open('xb') as f:f.write(imdata)
  pairref=live.archive(data,directory,source+'_'+pid+'_pair.json')
  rows.append({'source':source,'pair_id':pid,'generator_reported_kind':row['kind'],'pair_snapshot':pairref,'journal_prefix':journalref,'log_prefix':logref,'original_image':ref,'published_image':str(target.relative_to(root)),'independent_acceptance':'pending source terminal and strict checker'})
report={'created_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'scope':'Provisional review images from authenticated live producer; generator-reported candidates only, not independently accepted and not an expansion gate','bindings':bindings,'images':rows}
(out/'README.md').write_text('# Provisional Look→Flip review images\n\nThese are generator-reported candidates. Independent acceptance remains pending the source terminal record and strict source-specific checker; these images alone do not authorize expansion. The logged snapshot binds the immutable PBS assignment, audited image gate, complete journal prefix, pair hashes and existing image hashes.\n\n'+'\n'.join('- '+r['pair_id']+': '+r['published_image'] for r in rows)+'\n')
print('PROVISIONAL_REVIEW_IMAGES: '+json.dumps(report,sort_keys=True),flush=True)
s=root/'STATUS.md'
s.write_text(s.read_text()+'\n### Supplement15 first provisional LookFlip images\n\nPublished '+str(len(rows))+' generator-reported Look→Flip candidates from the running FP203/FP204 pilots in logs/review/t01v2_s15_provisional_lookflip_02. Independent acceptance remains pending terminal source records and the strict source adapter; none is counted toward expansion yet. Existing images were copied only after binding their hashes to authenticated complete journal prefixes and immutable gate/submission identity. See '+name+'.\n')
